# dsh-model-price — API pricing for DeepSeek Harness
**English** | Русский | Website

Per-model API prices, wallet balance and live session spend for
**DeepSeek Harness**. The plugin add

s a compact line under the chat composer —
`Session: $0.0123 · Wallet: $12.34 · Peak` — and a **Mode

ls & prices** section in
Settings where you enter what each model costs per million tokens, in USD o

r CNY,
separately for Peak and Off-Peak hours.

The plugin is a Host + Client bundle. It does not patch Harness, does not modify
session logs, and k
eeps all of its data in `~/.dsh/api-spend/`.

> **Unofficial.** This project is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored
> by DeepSeek. “Dee

pSeek” and “DeepSeek Harness” belong to their respective
> authors. See Non-affiliation.
## Screenshots

| Settings — Display | Settings — Models |
|:---:|:---:|
## What this plugin does

DeepSeek Harness reports token usage per step but has no per-model price table
and no wallet display
. This plugin adds both:
| Surface | What it shows | Where it lives |
| Composer line | Session spend, wallet balance, Peak / Off-Peak badge, live indicator | `conversati

on.composer.dock`, order 2 |
| Popover | Token composition, per-model cost, wallet split, child sess

ions, all-time total | Click the line |
| Settings section | Price table per model, currency, manual

FX rate, Off-Peak window, language | `settings.section`, order 30 |
| Host API | Prices, wallet and
session aggregation | `/api-spend/api/*` |

The plugin works from the durable session log: it folds
`assistant/message` usage into a session pro

jection and prices it on read. It
does not estimate tokens, does not rewrite logs, and does not bloc

prices it on read. It
does not estimate tokens, does not rewrite logs, and does not block requests.
## Features

- **Per-model price table** — input (cache miss), output, cache hit and cache
write, each with a Pea

k and an Off-Peak rate.
- **Two currencies** — enter prices in USD or CNY, display in one currency a

nd
convert with a manual rate stored in the settings.
- **Wallet** — real DeepSeek account balance p

lus bonus wallets; a local budget
can stand in when the account is unavailable.
- **Live session cos

t** — updates while the model works; retries are
de-duplicated and aborted steps without usage are r

eported, not guessed.
- **Peak / Off-Peak** — editable UTC window, orange Peak badge, green Off-Peak

badge, and the matching price column is used for each settlement.
- **Model sync** — one click mirr

ors the models bound in **Settings → Models**.
Providers with an empty model list contribute nothing

, and models removed from
that list disappear from the price table with their prices.
- **Localized*

* — 9 bundled languages with automatic discovery of new locale
files.
- **Best time** — the popover

shows the current or next Off-Peak block in local
time and a countdown until it starts (or until it

ends, when already active).
- **Search & Fetch costs** — successful `web_search` / `web_fetch` calls

are
counted and shown separately; they are free until 2026-10-31 16:00 UTC and
billed at $0.75 per

1,000 requests afterwards.
- **Update indicator** — optional check of the latest GitHub release (at

most
once every 6 hours), a **Check now** button and a link to the newer release in
the About block.
- **Dependency-free, build-free** — plain JavaScript, no runtime packages.
## Supported versions
| Component | Value |

| DeepSeek Harness | **0.2.x** — tested on **0.2.1-rc.2** (Desktop, Windows) |
| Profile | `desktop`

(Web/Desktop); any profile that mounts the Web UI |
| Node.js | bundled with DSH, **22.5+** |
| Plu
gin version | **1.9.1** |
[该节后续省略]
## Requirements
| Need | Why |

| **DeepSeek Harness 0.2.x** | Provides the Web UI, session projections and the account service |
|

**A Web/Desktop profile** | The composer line and the settings section are Web-UI slots |
| **DeepSe

ek account (optional)** | Only for the wallet balance; without it use the local-budget fallback |
|
**No build tools** | The bundle ships `index.js` and `client.js` as-is |

Works on Windows, macOS and Linux; the UI uses Harness theme tokens and follows
the active theme aut

ndows, macOS and Linux; the UI uses Harness theme tokens and follows
the active theme automatically.
## How it works
### What is counted
| Token bucket | Source | Charged at |

| Input (cache miss) | `usage.inputTokens` | input price |
| Cache read | `usage.cacheReadTokens` |

cache-hit price, falls back to input |
| Cache write | `usage.cacheWriteTokens` | cache-write price,

empty = free |
| Output | `usage.outputTokens` | output price |

`reasoningTokens` is already inside `outputTokens` and is not charged twice.
Child sessions are incl
uded while they are live and are shown separately.
## Data and privacy
| Data | Location | Notes |

| Prices, currency, rate, window, language | `~/.dsh/api-spend/config.json` | Plain JSON |
| All-tim

e token counters | `~/.dsh/api-spend/totals.json` | Token buckets only |
| Wallet balance | DeepSeek

account API | Cached 45 s in memory, never written to disk |
| Session usage | Harness session log

| Read through the projection, never modified |
| Update check | `api.github.com` Releases API | Opt
ional; one request per 6 h, no payload |

There are no analytics and no telemetry. The only outbound requests are the
account balance call mad

e by the Harness itself and the optional update check;
disable it in **Settings → Models & prices →

About → Check for updates**. The
FX rate is manual by design.
## Limitations

- **Web UI only.** There is no TUI/CLI rendering of the spend line.
- **Wallet is DeepSeek-specific.

** Other providers show the local-budget
fallback.
- **Completed child sessions** are only in the al

l-time total, not in the
current session line.
- **Prices are retroactive.** Editing a rate recalcul

ates history rather than
freezing the rate at settlement time.
- **No limits or blocking.** The plug

in reports money; it never stops a request.
- **FX is manual.** No exchange-rate service is called.
- **Locale files ship as-is.** A partial translation falls back key by key.
## Security

Do not paste account tokens, API keys or private session data into issues.
Report security problems

privately through GitHub Security Advisories; see
SECURITY.md.
